core: Both communities run a controlled component-substitution experiment: they take an agent pipeline, swap out exactly one module (the planning step in one case, the tool-selection module in the other) for an alternative version while holding every other part of the pipeline identical, and then measure how that single swap changes downstream outcomes (task success, action counts) relative to the unmodified baseline pipeline.
quote_1: keeping the exact same execution model but routing the planning step through a much cheaper backend
quote_2: The tool-selection module was then exchanged between two otherwise identical agent stacks.
